body:
by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  revert a₂
  induction h₁ with
  | @refl x =>
      intro a₂ h₂
      exact ⟨a₂, h₂, .refl a₂⟩
  | @red_I x =>
      intro a₂ h₂
      cases h₂ with
      | refl =>
          exact ⟨x, .refl x, .red_I x⟩
      | red_I =>
          exact ⟨x, .refl x, .refl x⟩
      | @par l l' r r' hl hr =>
          have hl' : l' = I := I_irreducible l' hl
          subst l'
          exact ⟨r', hr, .red_I r'⟩
  | @red_K x y =>
      intro a₂ h₂
      cases h₂ with
      | refl =>
          exact ⟨x, .refl x, .red_K x y⟩
      | red_K =>
          exact ⟨x, .refl x, .refl x⟩
      | @par l l' r r' hl hr =>
          obtain ⟨x', hx, hl'⟩ := Ka_irreducible x l' hl
          subst l'
          exact ⟨x', hx, .red_K x' r'⟩
  | @red_S x y z =>
      intro a₂ h₂
      cases h₂ with
      | refl =>
          exact ⟨x ⬝ z ⬝ (y ⬝ z), .refl _, .red_S x y z⟩
      | red_S =>
          exact ⟨x ⬝ z ⬝ (y ⬝ z), .refl _, .refl _⟩
      | @par l l' r r' hl hr =>
          obtain ⟨x', y', hx, hy, hl'⟩ := Sab_irreducible x y l' hl
          subst l'
          exact
            ⟨x' ⬝ r' ⬝ (y' ⬝ r'),
              .par (.par hx hr) (.par hy hr),
              .red_S x' y' r'⟩
  | @par x x' y y' hx hy ihx ihy =>
      intro a₂ h₂
      cases h₂ with
      | refl =>
          exact ⟨x' ⬝ y', .refl _, .par hx hy⟩
      | @red_I z =>
          have hx' : x' = I := I_irreducible x' hx
          subst x'
          exact ⟨y', .red_I y', hy⟩
      | @red_K u v =>
          obtain ⟨u', hu, hx'⟩ := Ka_irreducible a₂ x' hx
          subst x'
          exact ⟨u', .red_K u' y', hu⟩
      | @red_S u v w =>
          obtain ⟨u', v', hu, hv, hx'⟩ := Sab_irreducible u v x' hx
          subst x'
          exact
            ⟨u' ⬝ y' ⬝ (v' ⬝ y'),
              .red_S u' v' y',
              .par (.par hu hy) (.par hv hy)⟩
      | @par u u' v v' hu hv =>
          obtain ⟨p, hxp, hup⟩ := ihx hu
          obtain ⟨q, hyq, hvq⟩ := ihy hv
          exact ⟨p ⬝ q, .par hxp hyq, .par hup hvq⟩
